title: Rezoning to allow larger stores at 815 Hutchinson River Parkway, Bronx
summary: This zoning map amendment changes the Hutchinson River Parkway shopping center site in the Bronx from an M1-2 manufacturing district to a C8-3 commercial district. The change would let the existing shopping center lease space to individual retail stores larger than 10,000 square feet. The City Planning Commission issued a negative declaration finding no significant environmental impact, and the Council approved the change on September 24, 2026.
